intro: The facepalm emoji 🤦 is the internet's universal 'I can't believe this' — palm pressed to forehead in secondhand embarrassment or sheer disbelief. This page gathers the whole range: the person, man, and woman facepalm variants, the weary and exhaling 'done' faces for when the sigh is audible, the flat 😑 and eye-rolling 🙄 reactions for lower-grade frustration, and classic facepalm kaomoji like orz and (－‸ლ) that paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single face, or copy a ready-made combo set for chats, comments, and replies.
